_comment: Central configuration for Sentinel-E. Thresholds are intentionally exposed so the analyst can tune sensitivity without touching detection code.

demo._comment: The reproducible replay driver runs from the SOC host, which stands in for the Kali attacker (Kali has no SSH server we can drive, and WireGuard prevents source-IP spoofing). When true, the engine ATTRIBUTES stand-in traffic (any event whose source IP is the SOC) to network.attacker_ip, so stages 1-3 show a single coherent adversary origin on the console. This is attribution/relabelling for the demo, NOT spoofing; set false to see the true observed source IPs.

recon._comment: Recon (nmap) fires when a single source IP sends inbound SYNs to >= distinct_ports different ports within window_seconds.

brute_force._comment: Brute force (hydra) fires on >= failed_logins failed /login POSTs from one IP within window_seconds.

injection._comment: Regex-based: any shell metacharacter or command-substitution pattern in the ping host field.

reverse_shell._comment: Any outbound SYN from the Pi to a port in suspicious_ports (non-standard C2 ports) is flagged.

privesc._comment: A web/service user invoking sudo to reach uid=0 in the auth log.

persistence._comment: A new UID-0 line in /etc/passwd, a /etc/shadow change, or an sshd_config modification.

exfiltration._comment: Read (access) of a sensitive file correlated with an outbound transfer (SSH/SCP egress) within the correlation window.

dashboard._comment: NOTE: 8760 is used by the existing 'frame' dashboard on this box. Sentinel-E uses 8770 below to avoid a clash.
